title: core:update-spec-metadata
description: **Removed.** `UpdateSpecMetadata` merged agent-provided `optimizedDescription`/`optimizedContext` into a freshly-extracted metadata document and persisted the merged result. Persisted optimizations are now owned directly by `spec-lock.json` per-field optimization records (see [`core:spec-optimization`](../spec-optimization/spec.md)) and mutated only through `UpdatePersistedSpecOptimizations` (`specs optimizations set`/`clear`). Metadata has no external editor after this change — `UpdateSpecMetadata` MUST NOT exist as a Core public use case.
context: **Removed.** `UpdateSpecMetadata` merged agent-provided `optimizedDescription`/`optimizedContext` into a freshly-extracted metadata document and persisted the merged result. Persisted optimizations are now owned directly by `spec-lock.json` per-field optimization records (see [`core:spec-optimization`](../spec-optimization/spec.md)) and mutated only through `UpdatePersistedSpecOptimizations` (`specs optimizations set`/`clear`). Metadata has no external editor after this change — `UpdateSpecMetadata` MUST NOT exist as a Core public use case.

rules: `UpdateSpecMetadata` MUST NOT be exported from `@specd/core`, MUST NOT be mounted on `Kernel`, and MUST NOT have a `createUpdateSpecMetadata` composition factory. Callers that need to persist an LLM-optimized field MUST use `UpdatePersistedSpecOptimizations` instead, which writes directly to the spec's lock-owned optimization state and captures its own artifact/schema baseline.

scenarios.name: UpdateSpecMetadata is not exported
then: UpdateSpecMetadata and createUpdateSpecMetadata are not present

scenarios.name: Kernel does not mount UpdateSpecMetadata
then: the returned kernel has no updateSpecMetadata entry under kernel.specs

scenarios.name: Callers persist optimized fields through UpdatePersistedSpecOptimizations instead
given: a caller needs to persist an LLM-optimized description or context field
when: the caller looks for a supported write path
then: AND it does not call UpdateSpecMetadata
